issues.label: Special vs. general damages classification
issues.why: The court must correctly determine whether Yanling's claimed damages are special (requiring computation) or general.

issues.label: NRCP 16.1(a)(1)(A)(iv) disclosure scope
issues.why: Whether the rule required a detailed computation for the specific damages Yanling sought is central to dismissal.

issues.label: Adequacy of Yanling's damages disclosure
issues.why: The court must assess whether any computation was actually disclosed and whether it was sufficient.

issues.label: Sanction proportionality under NRCP 16.1/37
issues.why: Preclusion of evidence and dismissal are severe sanctions requiring analysis of appropriate factors.

issues.label: Willfulness or diligence of nondisclosure
issues.why: Whether Yanling's failure was willful, negligent, or justified affects sanction propriety.

issues.label: Substantial justification/harmlessness exception
issues.why: NRCP 37(c) excuses nondisclosure if substantially justified or harmless, which the court must consider.

issues.label: Prejudice to defendant
issues.why: The court must evaluate whether Yanhui suffered prejudice from late or missing computation.

issues.label: Dismissal with prejudice appropriateness
issues.why: Dismissing entire complaint with prejudice as a discovery sanction requires strong justification.

issues.label: Effect on claims not needing computation
issues.why: Whether return of the $200,000 investment could proceed without detailed computation must be addressed.

issues.label: Consideration of lesser sanctions
issues.why: The court must consider whether less drastic alternatives to dismissal were available.

issues.label: Existence of enforceable joint venture agreement
issues.why: The underlying breach of contract claim depends on whether an oral joint venture existed.

issues.label: Statute of Frauds for real property
issues.why: An unwritten agreement concerning real estate interests may implicate the statute of frauds.

issues.label: Unjust enrichment as equitable alternative
issues.why: Unjust enrichment may support recovery of the investment independent of damages computation.

issues.label: Conversion claim viability
issues.why: Whether conversion applies to money or property titled in defendant's name must be evaluated.

issues.label: Implied covenant claim independence
issues.why: The good faith and fair dealing claim's survival may turn on the contract's existence.

issues.label: Whether anything remained to litigate
issues.why: The court must determine if precluding special damages truly eliminated all triable issues.

issues.label: Opportunity to supplement disclosure
issues.why: Whether the one-week extension and its expiration were reasonable and fair must be assessed.

issues.label: Notice and due process before dismissal
issues.why: Yanling's opportunity to be heard on the case-ending sanction implicates due process.

issues.label: Consideration of late-filed supplemental computation
issues.why: Whether the court should have considered the eight-day-late computation affects the ruling.

issues.label: Standard of review for sanctions
issues.why: An appellate court must apply the correct deferential or de novo standard to the district court's rulings.
